environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed on AWS Lambda with Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 15. Connection pooling via Agroal (Quarkus built-in) with max-size=5. Database user 'app_rw' has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all tables in public schema. No query-level firewall. TOKEN_SIGNING_KEY env var set to 'k8s-default-hmac-key-2024' (default value from container image). Lambda function URL is publicly accessible with AuthType=NONE.

config.db_user_permissions: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on public.*
